decisions: scope_confirmation approved by human reviewer; proceeding with confirmed scope
Redirect hot path is fronted by an in-memory TTL cache (app/cache.py) to keep p95 redirect latency low without adding an external dependency.
Public write endpoints (shorten, shorten/bulk) are protected by a fixed-window rate limiter keyed per client IP to bound abuse.

Operational visibility is exposed as one aggregate summary endpoint rather than a full events API, matching the confirmed (not raw) scope from scope_confirmation.
